what: At 1440 the tall 597x868 cover crop at 50% 50% centres on the orchid: the smiling receptionist is cut out completely and the patient's face is sliced by the right edge, so the 'welcomed at the front desk' moment reads as a flower and two hands.
fix: object-position '12% 50%' to hold the receptionist's face and outstretched hand (check the same arrival crop on the other 5 pages that use this still).

what: The step shown is 'STEP 01 Your first visit: a cone-beam CT scan', but the photo is the Yomi robot in surgery, which belongs to step 02 (the day of surgery).
fix: Use still-cbct-suite.jpg for the first-visit step, or keep the robot only if the image changes per step and it sits on step 02.

what: The zirconia bridge sits in the right third of a mostly black 2:1 source, so at 50% 50% both widths show empty black with half the bridge cut off at the right edge.
fix: object-position '72% 50%' (centre of the bridge) at both widths.

what: Alt says 'A dental implant model' but the image shows a hand typing on a laptop keyboard; the same file is used 8 times on this page (hero plus 7 entry cards).

what: The card for 'After getting a full arch of teeth extracted, should I get full mouth implants?' shows a single-tooth implant render, not a full arch.
fix: Use hybrid-denture-model.jpg (full upper and lower prosthesis over implant abutments) with object-position '70% 50%'; it is not used elsewhere on the blog index.

what: This laptop-typing placeholder appears 8 times on the blog index (hero plus 7 cards), and it has nothing to do with this card's topic (a temporary prosthesis after implant surgery).
